# glass.sqdaitools

**glass.sqdaitools** is a toolkit for the whole GLASS data lifecycle:
query products from the [GLASS archive](https://glass.hku.hk/archive/),
map your region of interest onto the `h<h>v<v>` sinusoidal tiling,
expand a date range into composite DOY folders, batch-download with
resume + size verification, and post-process granules with terra (fill
values, scaling, reprojection, multi-tile mosaics, temporal composites).

> **中文简介**:glass.sqdaitools 是 GLASS(Global Land Surface
> Satellite)数据 全流程工具包:查询产品登记表、把研究区映射到正弦投影 h/v
> 瓦片、日期区间转 合成 DOY
> 文件夹、支持断点续传与大小校验的批量下载,以及基于 terra 的后处理
> (填充值、比例因子、重投影、多瓦片镶嵌、时间合成)。中文快速上手:
> [《快速上手(中文)》](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/articles/glass-quickstart-zh.html)。

## Installation

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("GISerDaiShaoqing/glass.sqdaitools")
```

## Quick start

``` r
library(glass.sqdaitools)
```

### 1. Which tiles does my study area need?

``` r
tiles <- glass_tiles_for_bbox(120.8, 30.6, 122.2, 31.9)  # Greater Shanghai
tiles
```

`h`/`v` are the sinusoidal tile indices used directly in GLASS file
names (e.g. `h28v05`). For a polygon/multipolygon study area use
`glass_tiles_for_sf(roi)`.

### 2. What products and variants exist?

``` r
glass_registry("LAI", verified_only = TRUE)
```

The registry bundles the archive’s directory structure for 130+ variants
(product × source × resolution); `LAI_MODIS_250M`, `NDVI_MODIS_250M`,
`EVI_MODIS_250M`, `FVC_MODIS_500M` and `Ta_MODIS` are verified against
real granules, including file-naming fragments and band metadata (fill
value, scale factor, valid range) used in the post-processing step.

### 3. Which composite folders cover my date range?

``` r
glass_doys("LAI_MODIS_250M", from = "2018-08-01", to = "2018-12-31")
```

`mode = "span"` keeps every composite overlapping the range (default);
`mode = "start"` keeps only composites that start inside it — the
semantics of the typical legacy scripting workflow.

### 4. One-shot fetch (list + download)

``` r
files <- glass_fetch(
  "LAI_MODIS_250M",
  from = "2018-08-01", to = "2018-12-31",
  tiles = "h28v05",
  out_dir = "data/glass/lai"
)
```

Downloads are retried, size-checked against the server, and can resume
from a partial `.part`; a `glass_manifest.csv` ledger is written into
`out_dir`. Set `dry_run = TRUE` to preview the manifest first.

### 5. Post-process to your region

``` r
mean_lai <- glass_process(
  files,
  roi = roi_sf,        # your study area (sf); its CRS is the target CRS
  product = "LAI_MODIS_250M",
  fun = "mean",        # temporal mean over all composite layers
  outfile = "glass_lai_mean.tif"
)
```

[`glass_process()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_process.md)
fills raw values (255 → `NA`, scaled correctly), groups granules by
composite date, mosaics tiles per date, reprojects, crops/masks to
`roi`, and can collapse layers with a function — the whole pipeline of a
typical GLASS post-processing script, parameterised.

### 6. Interactive download UI

``` r
glass_app()
```

Draw your ROI on a Leaflet map (click twice to frame a rectangle), pick
a verified variant and dates, preview the manifest, then download in one
click. Requires `shiny` and `leaflet`.

## GUI front end: D3L Tool

Prefer a desktop application? [D3L
Tool](https://github.com/GISerDaiShaoqing/D3LTool) ([online
docs](https://gisersqdai.top/D3LTool/)) is a NASA satellite download
manager. Its **v2.5.0** release integrates GLASS batch downloading built
on the skeleton of this package, while granule post-processing (fill
values, mosaics, reprojection, temporal composites) keeps running on
`glass.sqdaitools`. The two projects are designed as a matched pair:
**D3L Tool** for interactive search & download, **glass.sqdaitools** for
reproducible, scriptable processing.

## Acknowledgements

Data are publicly hosted by the GLASS product team
([glass.hku.hk](https://glass.hku.hk)). Please respect their citation
policies; the package only reads public directory listings.

# Package index

## 产品登记表 Registry

浏览 GLASS 归档变体、命名片段与波段元数据。 Browse archive variants,
naming fragments and band metadata.

- [`glass_registry()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_registry.md)
  [`glass_product_info()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_registry.md)
  : Query the GLASS product registry
- [`get_glass_product_table()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/get_glass_product_table.md)
  : Fetch the GLASS product overview table online

## 瓦片与时间 Tiles & DOY

研究区到 h/v 瓦片、日期区间到合成 DOY。 ROI-to-tile mapping and date
range to composite folders.

- [`glass_tiles_for_bbox()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_tiles_for_bbox.md)
  [`glass_tiles_for_sf()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_tiles_for_bbox.md)
  : Map a region of interest onto GLASS sinusoidal tiles
- [`glass_doys()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_doys.md)
  : Convert a date range to composite DOY folders

## 检索与下载 List & Download

目录清单与带断点续传的批量下载。 Folder listings and resumable batch
downloads.

- [`glass_list_files()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_list_files.md)
  : List files of a GLASS archive composite folder
- [`glass_download_file()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_download_file.md)
  : Download one GLASS file with resume support
- [`glass_download()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_download.md)
  : Batch download a GLASS file manifest
- [`glass_fetch()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_fetch.md)
  : Fetch GLASS granules for a variant, ROI and date range in one call

## 后处理 Post-processing

填充值/比例因子处理、镶嵌、重投影与时间合成。 Fill/scale handling,
mosaics, reprojection and composites.

- [`glass_read()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_read.md)
  : Read GLASS HDF granules with fill/scale handling
- [`glass_mosaic()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_mosaic.md)
  : Merge multi-tile GLASS rasters
- [`glass_process()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_process.md)
  : Reproject, mask and composite GLASS rasters for a region

## 交互界面 Interactive UI

- [`glass_app()`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_app.md)
  : Launch the interactive GLASS download interface

## 内置数据集 Data

瓦片查找表与产品登记表。 Tile lookup table and product registry.

- [`glass_tiles`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_tiles.md)
  : GLASS sinusoidal tile lookup table
- [`glass_products`](https://giserdaishaoqing.github.io/glass.sqdaitools/reference/glass_products.md)
  : GLASS product registry
